newsitem.title: USA: Funco to open 60 stores, not 40, this year.
newsitem.headline: Funco to open 60 stores, not 40, this year.

text.p: Funco Inc said Monday it would open 60 stores this year instead of 40 as previously planned.
The company said it increased the number of store openings because of its strong operating results during the first quarter and an upbeat outlook for the interactive entertainment industry.
Earlier Funco said it earned $635,000, or $0.10 a share, in the first quarter. Last year, it lost $309,000, or $0.05 a share, during the first quarter.
Comparable-store sales, or sales of stores open a year, rose 21 percent during the quarter. Net sales rose to $24 million from $18.9 million in the first quarter of last year.

"The company attributes the strong sales increase to the growing market penetration of Sony Playstation, Nintendo 64 adn Sega Saturn products," Funco said in a statement. "Increased sales and improved operating margins resulted in first quarter profitability for the first time in the company's history."
